image_description: A vintage light-blue Smith-Corona typewriter sitting on a wooden surface. The image focuses on the front view, showing the keyboard layout, the carriage return lever, and the brand logo. The subject of interest is the long, horizontal key at the bottom center of the keyboard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated rectangular key spanning the full width of the bottom keyboard row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is clearly visible as the longest key in the bottom row, extending horizontally across the central portion of the keyboard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Length is dramatically greater than any other key, roughly ten times the width of a standard letter key.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visually, the space bar is significantly wider than the adjacent keys (Shift, Z, M, etc.), consistent with the proportions of a standard typewriter/keyboard layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface is flat or slightly concave.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top surface of the space bar appears flat with rounded edges, typical of vintage typewriter keys.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Underside connects to a long stabilizer bar mechanism.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside and internal mechanical linkage (stabilizer bar) are completely occluded by the keycap itself and the camera angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Label is typically blank with no printed character.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar has no visible letters, symbols, or markings on its top surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Positioned centrally between modifier keys on the bottom row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is located in the bottom center, flanked by what appear to be Shift or Margin Release keys on either side.
The key exhibits a smooth, non-glossy texture consistent with aged plastic or bakelite used in vintage typewriters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Typically white, black, or gray to match keyboard color scheme.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is an off-white/cream color, matching the other keys and contrasting with the blue body, which fits the 'match keyboard color scheme' criteria.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Part of a standard computer or typewriter keyboard.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly integrated into the keyboard assembly of a Smith-Corona typewriter.

artifact_observations.location: Brand logo on the front panel ('Smith-Corona')
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text 'Smith-Corona' is recognizable but slightly distorted and uneven in thickness, characteristic of AI-generated text rendering where font consistency is imperfect.

The metal lever on the right side seems to merge into the body without a clear mechanical joint or pivot point, appearing somewhat fused with the casing.
